title: Alerts: experiment config propagation lag + attribution anomalies (route experiments)
author: Allison Grant
description: Context: Route-level experiments rely on control-plane config propagation into the routing/policy layer. During beta we observed occasional propagation lag and a few classes of attribution anomalies (missing experiment_id/variant_id tags, variant receiving ~0 traffic due to config/eligibility issues, and split skew early in rollout). This PR adds Prometheus/Alertmanager rules and annotations for the standard route experiments dashboards, with SRE-reviewed runbook links and recommended severities. Scope: (1) propagation lag/staleness alerts tied to the new propagation lag metric emitted by the redwood monorepo, (2) attribution drop-rate and missing-dimension alerts for experiment metrics/traces aggregation, (3) “variant 0 traffic” detection to catch misconfigured allocations or eligibility rules. Notes: rules are written to avoid cardinality blow-ups (no per-route fanout by default); high-cardinality drilldowns remain in Grafana dashboards. Related: redwood PR-28631 (adds config propagation lag metric), redwood PR-28734 (runbook URLs in alert payloads), observability-pack PR-1934 (dashboards). Threads: slack/eng-sre/1736455521-alert-thresholds-experiment-propagation-lag.json and slack/eng-sre/1738362044-attribution-drop-rate-alert-noise.json informed thresholds/windows. Rollout: enable in staging immediately; prod enabled behind the existing observability-pack release gate (see release notes section).

review_conversation: Sean Gallagher (review): Thresholds look reasonable, but please ensure paging severity only fires when we have evidence of user-impact. For propagation lag: can we differentiate config push stalled vs read-side staleness? Also please include runbook links as full URLs (not relative) and confirm the runbook has a clear “disable experiments feature flag / soft-stop” mitigation. Allison Grant (author): Updated severities: propagation lag is page only for >10m sustained + >X% of regions impacted; otherwise ticket. Added separate warning for read-side staleness vs publish-side lag based on the two metrics exposed in redwood PR-28631. Runbook link updated to full Confluence URL and added a ‘Mitigation: set experiments evaluator to safe-default + disable auto-stop kill switch’ section reference. Rafael Mendes (review): Attribution drop-rate alert window was too short; in previous incident it flapped on deploys. Suggest 15m window and a higher threshold for warning, plus a distinct alert for “attribution missing on streaming retries” if we can approximate it. Also please add an annotation pointing to the assignment debugging endpoint docs. Allison Grant (author): Adjusted to 15m window; warning at 2.5% sustained, critical at 7% sustained (per staging baselines). Added annotation to internal debug endpoint docs and the assignment debugging runbook. We can’t reliably isolate streaming retries here without new labels; added TODO + linked ENG-9026 follow-up. Logan Wright (review): Please confirm recording rule names align with metrics taxonomy notes and do not include route_id by default. Allison Grant (author): Confirmed: recording rules aggregate by {experiment_id, variant_id, region} and optionally by route_id only in dashboard queries. Also added comment blocks warning against expanding label sets in alerts. Final: Sean + Rafael approved after a quick live review of runbook steps and alert routing.
alert_rules_summary: Added alert groups: RouteExperimentsControlPlane and RouteExperimentsAttribution. New alerts: (1) RouteExperimentsConfigPropagationLagHigh (warning) and RouteExperimentsConfigPropagationLagCritical (page) based on propagation_lag_seconds p95 and percentiles across regions; (2) RouteExperimentsConfigStalenessHigh (warning) when evaluator uses stale config versions beyond SLO; (3) RouteExperimentsAttributionDropRateHigh (warning/critical) when attribution_drop_rate > thresholds; (4) RouteExperimentsVariantZeroTraffic (warning) when a variant receives <0.5% traffic for >20m while allocation is >=5%; (5) RouteExperimentsSplitSkewSuspected (ticket) when observed vs expected allocation diverges beyond a tolerance band for >30m (best-effort heuristic). All alerts include annotations: runbook_url, owner, and console_experiment_link template.
release_notes: Observability: Added standard Alertmanager rules for route experiments propagation lag and attribution anomalies, with tuned thresholds and runbook links (beta readiness).
